hero.heading: Bespoke Luxury & Timeless Sanctuary at {{hotelName}}
hero.description: Surrender to the coastal beauty and unhurried luxury of {{hotelName}}. Every suite is meticulously tailored for sanctuary, peace, and unforgettable moments.

about.title: A Century of Handcrafted Italian Hospitality
about.description: Founded on the cliffside cliffs of Amalfi, {{hotelName}} has welcomed royalty, artists, and discerning travelers since 1924. Built with travertine stone, hand-blown Venetian glass, and custom warm linen, every detail at {{hotelName}} celebrates effortless luxury.
about.quote: At {{hotelName}}, hospitality is not a service—it is an art form passed through generations.

rooms.title: The {{hotelName}} Royal Maharajah Suite
rooms.description: The crown jewel of {{hotelName}}. Featuring expansive marble balconies, floor-to-ceiling panoramic views of Lake Pichola, private heated jacuzzi, and dedicated 24-hour royal butler service.

rooms.title: Private Lakefront Villa Sanctuary
rooms.bed: 2 Royal King Beds + Private Sun Deck
rooms.description: A secluded multi-level villa at {{hotelName}}. Features a private plunge pool, teak dining pavilion, private chef kitchen, and private boat landing.

rooms.title: Royal Sunset Palace Penthouse
rooms.description: Perched on the top floor of {{hotelName}}, offering unobstructed 360-degree views of Udaipur. Includes marble wood-burning fireplace and curated royal art collection.

rooms.title: Artisan Garden Courtyard Suite
rooms.description: A peaceful retreat surrounded by {{hotelName}}'s heritage lotus fountains and marigold gardens. Features handcrafted teak furnishings and rain shower.

amenities.title: Infinity Sunset Pool
amenities.description: A heated freshwater infinity pool suspended over the Amalfi cliffside at {{hotelName}}, offering continuous poolside cocktail service.

amenities.title: Ristorante {{hotelName}} (2 Michelin Stars)
amenities.description: An extraordinary gastronomic journey curated by Executive Chef Lorenzo, featuring fresh Mediterranean catch and hand-harvested ingredients.

amenities.title: Thermae Spa & Wellness Sanctuary
amenities.description: Rejuvenate at {{hotelName}} with holistic thermal mud treatments, hydrothermal stone baths, and bespoke organic facial therapies.

experiences.title: Private Yacht Sunset Cruise
experiences.subtitle: Charter {{hotelName}}'s private Riva yacht along the Capri coast.

experiences.title: Sommelier Wine Masterclass
experiences.subtitle: Explore our 3,000-bottle subterranean cellar with {{hotelName}}'s head sommelier.

experiences.title: Helicopter Capri Excursion
experiences.subtitle: Soar above the Faraglioni rocks with private helipad pickup directly from {{hotelName}}.

reviews.comment: {{hotelName}} is hands down the finest retreat on the Amalfi coast. The level of care, the private terrace views, and the food at Ristorante {{hotelName}} are beyond compare.
Our anniversary stay at {{hotelName}} felt like living inside an Italian fairytale. The team anticipated every request before we even asked!
The peacefulness of the gardens, the scent of fresh lemon groves, and the seamless service make {{hotelName}} our annual summer tradition.

faq.q: How do I request a reservation or check availability at {{hotelName}}?
faq.a: You can select your arrival and departure dates using the reservation bar on our website or click 'Book Your Stay' to select your preferred suite. Our concierge team responds within 1 hour.

faq.q: What are check-in and check-out times at {{hotelName}}?
faq.a: Standard check-in is from 15:00 onwards, and check-out is until 12:00 noon. Early check-in and late check-out can be arranged via butler services upon availability.
